name: Rozovaja nit'
source: Larisa is just your ordinary college girl. Cute, friendly, sometimes moody. But her boring springtime days a about to end when she faces a whirlwind of emotions her maiden heart not yet ready for...
translation: Larisa只是一名普通的女大学生，可爱、友善，偶尔也会闹点小脾气。然而，当尚未做好准备的少女心遭遇一阵情感旋风，她那乏味的春日生活也即将告终……
